--capture-groups.Name: --capture-groups
--capture-groups.description: Replaces non-capturing groups by capturing ones

--colorize.Name: --colorize
--colorize.description: Provides syntax highlighting for the resulting regular expression

--digits.Name: --digits
--digits.description: Converts any Unicode decimal digit to \d

--escape.Name: --escape
--escape.description: Replaces all non-ASCII characters with unicode escape sequences

--file.Name: --file
--file.description: Reads test cases on separate lines from a file

--ignore-case.Name: --ignore-case
--ignore-case.description: Performs case-insensitive matching, letters match both upper and lower case

--min-repetitions.Name: --min-repetitions
--min-repetitions.description: Specifies the minimum quantity of substring repetitions to be converted if --repetitions is set [default: 1]

--min-substring-length.Name: --min-substring-length
--min-substring-length.description: Specifies the minimum length a repeated substring must have in order to be converted if --repetitions is set [default: 1]

--non-digits.Name: --non-digits
--non-digits.description: Converts any character which is not a Unicode decimal digit to \D

--non-spaces.Name: --non-spaces
--non-spaces.description: Converts any character which is not a Unicode whitespace character to \S

--non-words.Name: --non-words
--non-words.description: Converts any character which is not a Unicode word character to \W

--repetitions.Name: --repetitions
--repetitions.description: Detects repeated non-overlapping substrings and converts them to {min,max} quantifier notation

--spaces.Name: --spaces
--spaces.description: Converts any Unicode whitespace character to \s

--with-surrogates.Name: --with-surrogates
--with-surrogates.description: Converts astral code points to surrogate pairs if --escape is set

--words.Name: --words
--words.description: Converts any Unicode word character to \w
